dimensions.description: Required entities, actions, counts, and relationships are present without contradicting the visual brief.
Approved character identity, distinctive marks, and role assignment remain recognizable and unconfused.
Required visible text is exact and ordered, while forbidden or unexpected text is absent.
Subjects and scientific objects are structurally plausible, legible, and free from material rendering artifacts.
Final encoded publication bytes retain required subjects and text inside the reviewed safe area.
A publication batch avoids exact or near duplicates while preserving identity consistency.

issues.description: A core topic entity required by the case-specific criteria is absent.
Required entities are present but their action or relationship contradicts the criteria.
The scene is broadly relevant but does not make a non-critical context unambiguous.
A required approved character is replaced, swapped, or no longer recognizable.
A distinctive identity mark required by the criteria is missing or materially altered.
Identity evidence is incomplete or borderline and requires human inspection.
Required visible text is missing, duplicated, misspelled, or out of order.
Forbidden, unexpected, watermark, or machine-like text is visible.
Text recognition confidence is insufficient for automatic acceptance.
A subject or scientific object has a material structural defect.
Visible noise, seams, halos, or texture artifacts reduce publication quality.
The scene remains usable but hierarchy or focus needs human review.
Final publication cropping removes a required subject or material action.
Required text is clipped or outside the reviewed publication safe area.
Visible text remains present but may be too small at the target viewport.
The batch contains an exact publication-byte or approved exact-content duplicate.
Two images are perceptually close enough to require a diversity review.
The batch repeats scene, camera, or action axes despite different bytes.
A provider returned a bounded issue outside the closed taxonomy; manual review is required.
